kept.name: knowledge-graph-construction-anthropic
kept.reason: Directly comparable: a pipeline that builds a typed-entity knowledge graph, resolves duplicate entities, and answers multi-hop queries over subgraphs with citations, plus a precision/recall eval harness.

kept.name: opencode-fff-search
kept.reason: Shows how to make lexical search fast for agents: an in-process index, a bigram pre-filter, frecency ranking and a fallback chain, all useful ideas for your lexical layer.

kept.name: agentic-resource-discovery
kept.reason: A spec for semantic natural-language search over static catalog manifests, which moves selection out of the LLM context. Close to what you're doing by adding embeddings to a catalog of records.

kept.name: agentconnect
kept.reason: A comparable agent memory and knowledge system: each agent keeps its own memory, approved knowledge is shared with all agents on demand, and Mem0 is an optional backend.

kept.name: ecc-github
kept.reason: Includes session memory persistence and a 'continuous learning' system that extracts patterns with confidence scores, a competing take on agent memory.

kept.name: decomposition-over-context
kept.reason: Argues for keeping decisions in durable repo files rather than relying on compaction summaries or the context window. This supports a persistent typed-record memory design.

kept.name: model-workspace-protocol
kept.reason: A related approach: plain markdown files in a filesystem layout serve as the agent's context and orchestration layer instead of a framework.

kept.name: obsidian-skills
kept.reason: Covers markdown knowledge vaults with wikilinks and properties, the same model as typed markdown records linked in a graph. The entry also mentions a kb wiki knowledge layer.

kept.name: scheduled-multi-agent-coordinator
kept.reason: Notes Hermes' persistent memory and cites research on memory-pollution attacks against persistent agents, a risk your memory system should plan for.

kept.name: claude-skills-rezvani
kept.reason: Has a RAG-architect skill and a self-improving-agent skill that curates memory automatically. Worth checking against your retrieval and curation design.

kept.name: internal-agent-permission-sprawl
kept.reason: An incident where an over-broad index exposed confidential documents through a knowledge-base assistant. The lesson is to scope what your memory system indexes.
